## How you tested it
Per `CONTRIBUTING.md`: this project's house rule is verify against the real running app, not just read the diff. What did you actually run/click/observe?



## Checklist
- [ ] Ran it locally (`npm start`, and `npm run electron` if the change touches the desktop shell) and actually exercised the change, not just read the code
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, or personal file paths in any commit, log output, or screenshot included here
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` (new entry under a version heading, or a note under `## Unreleased` if you're not sure which version this lands in)
- [ ] Updated `README.md` if this changes user-facing behavior, setup steps, or a documented limitation
